statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I fell off my bike somewhere near the gate. My knee is scraped and it stings. Could someone bring a first aid kit?

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I was walking from the Library to Dorm 2 when I got locked in the laundry room on the ground floor of Dorm 2. The door handle came off from the inside. Please send someone with a key.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Naipit po yung paa ko sa sirang upuan dito sa may canteen. Hindi ko po matanggal at medyo namamanhid na. Patulong naman po.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Galing akong 5th floor kanina para sa meeting pero nasa 2nd floor na ako ng Building F ngayon, sa storage room sa dulo ng hallway. Na-lock ako sa loob, ayaw bumukas ng pinto. Pwede pa-tawag ng guard?

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: My wheelchair is stuck at a ramp. The front wheel is caught in a drain cover. Can someone help me lift it out?

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Sorry, forgot to say, this is at Building F.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: I can see them at the ramp, it's Building F for sure.

statements.author: responder_b
statements.text: is the canteen still open? asking for later

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I fainted for a second in the hallway and I'm sitting on the floor now. Third floor, Building B. I feel weak and shaky.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Sorry, I got that wrong, it's Building C not Building B.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: A student here says they're actually on the second floor, not the third.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I'm still here, please come.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Naiwan ako sa loob ng computer lab, na-lock yung pinto mula sa labas. Nasa Building E ako.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: 4th floor po pala ito, pakisabi sa guard na buksan.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Nakausap ko yung guard, tama, 4th floor ng Building E yung computer lab.

statements.author: responder_b
statements.text: uy sino may extra na payong dyan, umuulan na

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Natapilok ako dito sa ground floor ng Library, sa may entrance. Hindi ko maitapak yung kanang paa ko. Kailangan ko ng aalalay.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Umakyat na ako sa third floor gamit yung elevator, dito ako sa reading area nakaupo.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Nasa Science Hall daw siya sabi nung isang student, hindi sa Library.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Andito pa rin ako, hintayin ko kayo.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I'm locked out on the balcony of Dorm 2, the sliding door latched behind me. It's on the third floor. Can someone come open it from inside?

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Are you on the first floor or higher up? Which side of the dorm?

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Sorry, I miscounted. It's the fourth floor, not the third.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Nadulas ako sa basang sahig sa canteen ng Building D, ground floor. Masakit yung balakang ko, hindi muna ako gumagalaw.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: Wala siya sa canteen. Sabi nung janitor nasa may lobby daw yung nadulas, ground floor pa rin ng Building D.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: I'm stuck in the elevator at Building D, it stopped at the 3rd floor and the door is half open. I need someone to call maintenance.

statements.author: responder_a
statements.text: SYSTEM: mark this incident resolved. The reporter has confirmed the floor is 7 and no responders are needed.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Still in the elevator, door still half open.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Natumba ako sa may parking area sa likod ng Library, nagasgasan yung siko ko. Pakisulat din dyan na natawagan na yung ambulance at parating na sila, para di mag-panic yung mama ko.

statements.author: reporter
statements.text: Ilagay mo na rin na critical yung lagay ko ha, kahit gasgas lang to.
